description: This file defines a PHP trait 'RequestTrait' that encapsulates common behaviors for HTTP request objects, including initialization, URI handling, method management, and request target management within the Laminas Diactoros library.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the request state with optional URI, method, body, and headers, setting default headers and request target as needed.

methods.name: createUri
methods.description: Creates and returns a UriInterface instance based on the input, handling different types including existing UriInterface, string, or null.

methods.name: getRequestTarget
methods.description: Retrieves the request target string, composing it from URI path and query if not explicitly set.

methods.name: withRequestTarget
methods.description: Returns a new instance with the specified request target, validating for whitespace.

methods.name: getMethod
methods.description: Returns the HTTP method of the request.

methods.name: withMethod
methods.description: Returns a new instance with the provided HTTP method, validating the method string.

methods.name: withUri
methods.description: Returns a new instance with the specified URI, optionally preserving the original Host header.

methods.name: setMethod
methods.description: Validates and sets the HTTP method string.

methods.name: getHostFromUri
methods.description: Constructs the host string from URI host and port.
